title: A man stood on his dropping barge, between clamps of turf
html_source:
This may be an allusion to Charon, the boatman who transports the dead across the river into the underworld of Hades.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charon

Charon is not mentioned in Homer’s Odyssey. Odysseus accesses denizens of the underworld by sailing to the edge of the earth, digging a pit, and filling it with various sacrifices. The spirits of the dead then appear from the pit.
Odyssey Book 11
